telegramBotTokenHint: , please fill in the Bot Token on the right
reloginStarted: Login reset, generating new QR code…
wechatInProgress: There's already a WeChat scan in progress; finish or close it first
wechatPendingLogin: There's already a WeChat account that hasn't completed login; finish the scan in its 'Login' section or delete it
emptyHelp: Telegram needs a token from BotFather; WeChat needs a QR scan to log in. After binding to an agent, that agent can send and receive messages in this chat.
tgWaitMessageTitle: Send a message to your bot
tgWaitMessageHelp: Send any message to the new bot — we'll detect it automatically and finish setup.
botTokenSet: Already set ···{{tail}}. Paste a new token to replace; leave empty to keep.
botFatherSteps: In @BotFather: send /newbot to create a bot and copy the token; or send /mybots, pick an existing bot → API Token. The token looks like 123456:ABC-DEF…; paste it in the box above and click save.
sendMessageToBind: Send any message to {{bot}} to bind chat
wechatScanHint: Scan to log in with WeChat
wechatStep1: 1. WeChat → Settings → Plugins → find "WeChat ClawBot" (requires WeChat 8.0.70+)
wechatStep2: 2. Open ClawBot → tap "Start Scan" to scan the QR code above
wechatStep3: 3. Confirm authorization — token is permanent, no re-scan after restart
fieldBindAgentHelp: After binding, IM messages are forwarded to the agent and the agent's replies are pushed back to IM. Each agent can only be bound to one account per platform.
forwardIncoming: Forward incoming messages to the agent
forwardOff: When off, only agent → one-way push
disabledOff: When off, no connection / no polling
agentReplyHint: Replies from the bound agent are streamed back through the AI gateway (tool results excluded)
scanWithWeChat: Scan QR code in WeChat ClawBot Mini Program
scanSuccessNote: After scanning, the account is added automatically. Token is permanent — no re-scan needed after backend restart.
fieldBindAgentHelpNoGateway: After binding, IM messages are forwarded to the agent and its replies are pushed back to IM (non-gateway agents are captured via the local MITM audit). If the agent is offline, messages fall back to w-1001. Each agent can only be bound to one account per platform.
